title: Chained compute dispatches: the per-buffer dependency barrier's source stages omit COMPUTE_SHADER
expected_finding: the barrier cmdDispatch records for scan_block_sums (and scan_data) before the addBlockSums dispatch has srcStage VERTEX_SHADER | FRAGMENT_SHADER | TRANSFER, so the scanBlocks dispatch's SHADER_WRITE of scan_block_sums / scan_data is outside its first scope: read-after-write (and write-after-write on scan_data) between the two dispatches in the same command buffer
